productDirection.summary: Canvas Fogworks is both a general visual/pixel editor and a game-authoring environment.

items.summary: Extend the passing per-user, software-rendered Sandbox installer lifecycle (fresh install, synthetic-version upgrade, uninstall, project/recovery preservation) with historical-release migration, GUI/per-machine installer coverage and hardware-GPU validation. An original vector icon is packaged. Personal publisher metadata and signing are intentionally omitted at the user's request.
Continue extracting cohesive panels and workflows from App.tsx; project files, image-sequence import, workspace/runtime controls, the 3D inspector and the folders drawer are tested seams.
Extend delivered native glTF TRS sampling, bounded CPU skinning and two-clip pose blending with GPU skinning, automatic crossfades, morph animation and component-instance playback.

Extend delivered schema-81 graphs (events/branches/actions, delays, bounded repeats, reusable project assets, saved continuations and editor debugging) with general behavior lifecycle, richer variables and callable graph functions. Named inputs, 2D/3D interaction/spawning/checkpoints and current-level progress are delivered. Input settings UI, full prefabs, cross-level state, cross-build save migrations and process-crash/relaunch acceptance remain open.

Complete clean-machine standalone 3D acceptance, custom font packaging, unsupported-feature diagnostics and release provenance. Shared 3D loading/session, inline manifest/resolver, package export, embedded-payload checksum, event/render host and unsigned Windows unpacked build are implemented; broad runtime feature coverage and F1 certification remain open.

Extend delivered OBB/sphere contacts and opt-in gravity/restitution with dynamic-body impulses, angular dynamics, slopes/character behavior, hierarchical collider transforms and a replaceable backend boundary.
Extend delivered embedded sound cues and bounded Web Audio playback with a total decoded-byte cache budget, streaming music, buses and dedicated reusable audio assets.

Extend delivered bounded linked-level/image/3D relocation and five real writer-process crash checkpoints with browser recovery restore, full desktop crash/relaunch automation and transactional dependency-folder rollback. Renamed self-linked entry files and external image URLs are explicitly refused during cross-folder relocation; custom fonts are not packaged.

Calibrate release budgets across hardware using delivered CPU/GPU, 1024-square raster, 500-instance component, 100 animated-mesh and disk asset-reload benchmarks. Add longer soak runs, larger textured scenes and exact retained-memory accounting before choosing performance rewrites.
Decide whether SVG and Canvas need WebGL-equivalent per-fragment mesh-relief normals and self-occlusion; flat-surface scene lighting is now shared.
Implement minmax/fit-content tracks and remaining explicit grid-placement refinements.
Restore incremental dirty-state reuse for documents containing component instances.
Defer AI, full plugins and collaboration until production-hardening work is established.
